Dense neighbour-joining ladder

Source: R/data.R
scale_njdense.Rd

Neighbour-joining-only accuracy (no Bayesian inference) across a dense range of character counts, nC in {10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500}, for both continuous and discrete data, several replicate simulations per (tree, nC) cell.

Usage

data(scale_njdense)

Format

A data frame with columns tree, rep (replicate index), nC, arm ("cont_raw", "cont_sq", "cont_pc12" or "disc_cor"; see scale's NJ_* columns for the equivalent distances) and CID.

Source

hominin-pca-scale/R/09_scale_njdense.R.
